# BCGov Crow - v0.7.6

## Release type

Patch release improving the usability and accessibility of generated business-rules reports.

## Summary

This release makes large business-rules reports easier to navigate and review without
removing report content. Generated HTML reports now provide collapsible context and
sections, direct rule indexing, keyword search, linked references, safer responsive
layouts, and more resilient printing and accessibility behavior.

## Highlights

- Large reports can be scanned through a compact rule index or searched by rule ID,
  title, statement, or implementation evidence.
- Report scope, summary, documentation coverage, filters, diagrams, and open questions
  can be collapsed to reduce scrolling while retaining their complete contents.
- Documentation sources, documentation references, and diagram rule references now
  provide direct in-document navigation, with safe HTTPS sources rendered as links.
- Wide tables, code paths, symbols, commits, and diagrams remain usable on narrow
  screens and large displays.

## Changes

- Widened the report content area and added responsive table and diagram containers.
- Added safe wrapping for long implementation citations and semantic table row headers.
- Added a text-alternative disclosure for diagrams and improved diagram heading navigation.
- Preserved filtered report completeness when printing and improved printed header contrast.
- Improved forced-colors behavior, link states, checkbox target sizing, and skip-link focus.
- Added hash-aware disclosure behavior so section navigation opens its collapsed target.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: passed.
- Archive inspection: passed; package contents were checked for local state and evidence.
- Additional checks: business-rules validation suite passed all 60 cases; JavaScript syntax
  validation passed; local browser smoke checks covered section navigation and keyword
  filtering; the local SonarQube quality gate passed.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.7.6 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.7.6.zip --global --target copilot
```
